content:
Apple today announced it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13) with the theme "Welcome Home".

Apple will unveil a brand new Home product line on October 13, as teased by Greg Joswiak

Apple will launch new products next Tuesday (October 13), as revealed by Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak in a teaser video. The following is the short video released by Joswiak.

Apple is expected to introduce several brand new Home products at the event, including:

Previously leaked home accessory products co-developed by Apple and LG may also make their first appearance next week.

Alongside Joswiak's date announcement, Apple has also sent invitations to the media to attend the "Apple Experience" special event, to be held at 9:00 AM Eastern Time in Tribeca, New York.

The following is the invitation shared by Marques Brownlee:

Featured comment posted by JP

Three products. I'm guessing it's  Car, in Space Grey, White, and another slightly different White.

Earlier this year, when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it held a similar "Apple Experience" event for the media. At that time, the new products were released in the form of press releases over several consecutive days before their official debut.

However, the market widely expects that all of Apple's brand new Home products will be officially unveiled on the same day.

Whether Apple will simultaneously upload the full product introduction video at 9:00 AM Eastern Time remains unconfirmed. This website will continue to update everyone with the latest news.

Which new product are you most looking forward to Apple launching on October 13? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
